BiblicalUsage: Bigvai means in my bodies, and he is the head of a family that came home from exile. Ezra 2:14 counts the children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six, and Nehemiah 7:19 counts them again. Ezra 8:14 names Uthai and Zabbud, of the sons of Bigvai, coming up with Ezra — seventy males, returning to the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the children of Bigvai are the return in miniature: counted twice, named by family, and home at last.
